description: Pescadero Old Haul Road Bridge Repair Repair or Replacement of Six Crib Crossings is a dataset listed in County of San Mateo open data portal (datahub.smcgov.org), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by County of San Mateo. PRKBR Measure K Performance. Coverage: San Mateo County, California. The portal files it under the category Government. Its tags are measure k. The table has 3 columns. Attribution on the portal: Parks Department, County of San Mateo. The portal shows 2019-01-28 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datahub-smcgov-org-portal.
